why: Severs the wreck dev flag from the renderer, so `?dev=1&wreck=tilt` parses, validates and shows as set in the Developer panel while no wreck is ever built. Issue #232 leaves the removal effect open -- 'fade, crumble, sink, or otherwise' -- so the three arms exist to be turned on and compared in play; an arm that never reaches the renderer reads as 'the decoration does not help' rather than 'it never drew'. Invisible to render/wreck.test.ts, which constructs the system directly, and to the exact-object option tests, which only pin the default null.
killedBy: startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default threads the wreck dev flag's chosen arm through to the renderer (issue #232)
